description: Delivered 02/1968; flew the first sortie of Operation Anode in the Solomon Islands 05/08/2003. Displayed near the entrance to the Army Aviation Training Centre. Identity and current holder confirmed on ADF-Serials.

Second pre-production Nomad, displayed at the 1972 Farnborough Airshow as VH-SUR and leased to the Australian Army. Crashed 03/10/1973 and rebuilt as a training aid marked A18-300; ADF-Serials doubts it ever wore the serial in service. Gate guard at Oakey. Identity and current holder confirmed on ADF-Serials.
